# open_for_write { #crossrepo.cache.open_for_write }

```python
crossrepo.cache.open_for_write(sha, root=None)
```

Prepare to stream an object into the cache.

Content is written to the temporary path and then renamed, so an interrupted
write cannot leave a truncated object in the cache. The temporary path is
unique to the caller, so neither can a concurrent one.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Key to store the object under.

<code>[**root**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Cache root. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.cache_root`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   ``(temporary_path, final_path)``. Parent directories are created. The temporary path differs on every call; the final path does not.
